code.KEY_MISSING: Add your YouTube API key in Settings to search.
code.KEY_REFUSED: Google refuses this API key: check it in Google Cloud.
code.KEY_RESTRICTED: This API key is restricted to something else (a website, another API): allow YouTube Data API v3 without a website restriction.
code.NO_CLIENT: Add your OAuth client in Settings first.
code.NOT_CONNECTED: Connect your YouTube channel in Settings.
code.TOKEN_EXPIRED: The Google connection has expired (7 days in testing mode): connect again in Settings.
code.SCOPE_MISSING: Your Google account is connected without YouTube: connect again in Settings and allow YouTube.
code.NO_CHANNEL: This Google account has no YouTube channel yet.
code.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Today's YouTube quota is used up; it comes back tomorrow (Pacific time).
code.RATE_LIMITED: YouTube asks to slow down: try again in a moment.
code.COMMENTS_DISABLED: Comments are turned off on this video.
code.TIMEOUT: No answer in time: try again.
code.SERVER_ERROR: YouTube has a problem on its side: try again later.
code.PERMISSION_DENIED: Mnemosyne OS did not allow this app to do that.
code.NO_HOST: Open this app inside Mnemosyne OS.
code.NOT_FROM_A_GESTURE: Click in the window to do this.
code.TOO_SOON: One search at a time: try again in a second.
code.HAS_WHITESPACE: A key has no spaces: copy it again.
code.LOOKS_LIKE_URL: That is a link, not a key.
code.SEAL_REFUSED: This computer could not seal the key; nothing was saved.
code.UNEXPECTED_SHAPE: it does not look like a Google key (AIza…), check it
code.BAD_CLIENT: Give both the client ID and the secret.
code.ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE: This computer cannot seal secrets; nothing was saved.
code.CLIENT_NOT_PERSISTED: The client could not be saved.
code.CONSENT_REFUSED: The connection was refused in the browser.
code.CONSENT_TIMEOUT: Nothing came back from the browser in 5 minutes: try again.
code.CONNECT_FAILED: Google refused the connection: check the client ID and secret.
code.NOT_A_VIDEO: That is not a video file YouTube takes.
code.PICK_FAILED: The file could not be opened.
code.MADE_FOR_KIDS_UNSET: Say whether the video is made for kids.
code.UNKNOWN_JOB: This upload is no longer known (the app was restarted).
code.NOTHING_TO_PLAY: Nothing is loaded in the player.
code.FULL: No room left: the playlists hold their maximum.
code.DUPLICATE: A playlist already has that name.
code.NOT_READY: Still reading your playlists: try again in a moment.
code.LIBRARY_UNREADABLE: Your saved playlists could not be read.
code.NOT_A_YOUTUBE_LINK: That is not a YouTube video link.
code.NO_MUSIC_FOLDER: Choose your music folder in the Music tab first.
code.NO_TRACKS: No song in the music folder.
code.READ_DIR_FAILED: The music folder could not be read.
code.READ_FAILED: This song could not be read.
code.TRACK_TOO_LARGE: This song is over 50 MB, the limit of Mnemosyne OS.
code.FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: This audio format does not play here.
code.PLAYER_FAILED: The player could not play this.
code.PLAYER_SILENT: The YouTube player does not answer.
code.PLAYER_IDENTITY: YouTube refuses this player (error 153): Mnemosyne OS needs an update.
code.YT_SIGN_IN_WALL: YouTube asks you to sign in to confirm you are not a robot (it asks the same on its own site from this connection). Press « Sign in » below, sign in in the window that opens, then « Try again ». Or open the video where you are already signed in.
code.BAD_VIDEO_ID: This video link is not valid.
code.VIDEO_NOT_FOUND: This video was removed or made private.
code.NOT_EMBEDDABLE: Its owner does not allow this video outside YouTube.
code.NO_PRESET: That equalizer preset does not exist.
code.NO_LOOK: That visualizer look does not exist.
code.UNSUPPORTED_OS: Not available on this system yet.
code.CAPTURE_FAILED: The computer’s sound could not be read.
code.SPECTRUM_BUSY: Another app is already showing the computer’s sound.

why.ambiguous: Two desktops are called MnemoPlayer: rename one, then try again.
why.full: All 9 desktops are taken. Open the windows on this desktop instead?
why.nowhere: There is no single view to go back to: close one of these windows.
why.unheard: The board cannot open here: open MnemoPlayer on the canvas.
why.gesture: Press the button in the window to open the board.
